title: Restructure website to 3-5 pages from current single-page layout

requirements.text: Analyze the current single-page layout (HomePage.tsx with 7 sections: Hero, Why, Testimonials, MenuHighlights, Celebration, Location, FinalCTA) and restructure it into 3-5 separate routable pages with distinct URLs

quotes: okay how many pages are in version 10. how can i make it be for 3 to 5 pages

acceptanceCriteria: Current 7 sections are reorganized into 3-5 logical page groupings
Each new page has its own route (e.g., /about, /menu, /contact)
Navigation structure allows users to move between pages
All existing content and functionality is preserved across the new page structure

requirements.text: Update the Header component navigation to include links to all new pages, maintaining the existing admin button and Order Now CTA while adding page navigation menu items
acceptanceCriteria: Header displays navigation links to all 3-5 pages
Current admin button and Order Now CTA remain functional
Navigation is responsive and works on mobile devices
Active page is visually indicated in the navigation

requirements.text: Update React Router configuration in App.tsx to support the new multi-page structure with routes for each of the 3-5 pages while maintaining the existing /admin route
acceptanceCriteria: All 3-5 new pages have defined routes
Navigation between pages works without page refresh

requirements.text: Ensure internal links and CTAs (Order Now buttons, scroll-to-location functionality, menu view buttons) work correctly across the new multi-page structure, updating any section-scroll behavior to page navigation where appropriate
acceptanceCriteria: Order Now buttons navigate to the appropriate page with location information
All CTAs across pages function correctly
No broken links or navigation errors

constraints: Do not modify the existing authentication system or admin functionality
Do not change the backend/main.mo file
Preserve all existing content from the 7 current sections
Maintain the luxury bakery theme and visual design
Keep the existing color palette and typography unchanged
nonGoals: Adding new content or features beyond restructuring existing sections
Changing the backend data models or API
Redesigning the visual appearance or brand identity
Adding authentication requirements to public pages
